API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIApplication Segment ManagementMoves application of one microtenant to another
Moves application of one microtenant to another
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/application/:applicationId/move

Moves application of one microtenant to another

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

applicationId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Application Segment.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
targetMicrotenantId
int64
targetSegmentGroupId
int64
targetServerGroupId
int64
